description: The mini player is a small, always-on-top, borderless window that loads a LOCAL page (mini.html) — not the remote origin — so it needs no remote.urls grant. It drives playback through the app's own mini_* commands (allowed by default for any capable window) and needs a few core window/event grants: resize (collapse to a tiny box), start-dragging the frameless surface, show/hide/focus, and event listen/emit for the sk-np / sk-state pushes from media.rs.
